stateHint.off: The VPN runs on the server: deploy with DEPLOY_VPN=yes (see the steps below). On a computer that syncs with the server the devices are shown, the VPN itself is on the server.
stateHint.starting: The server made its keys; the VPN container answers within a minute or two.
stateHint.up: Devices connect to this address. All their traffic goes through your server.
stateHint.down: The VPN container has not answered for over 3 minutes: devices cannot connect.

phone.1: Install AmneziaWG from Google Play (or AmneziaVPN — it reads the same QR code).
phone.2: Here: Add a device → Phone, then in the app: + → Scan from QR code.
phone.3: Turn it on: the device's dot here turns green within a minute.
phone.4: Without internet when the VPN is off: in the phone's VPN settings (on Xiaomi: Connection & sharing → VPN) → AmneziaWG → Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN.

computer.1: Install the AmneziaWG client for Windows from its GitHub releases.
computer.2: Here: Add a device → Computer → File .conf; in the client: Import tunnel(s) from file → Activate.
computer.3: All traffic goes through the tunnel, so the client blocks the internet while the VPN is off (its "Block untunneled traffic" is on by itself).

server.1: Add a DNS A record vpn.<your domain> → the server's IP at your domain's registrar. Moving the VPN to another IP later changes only this record.
server.2: Put DEPLOY_VPN=yes into deploy/deploy.local.env and deploy: the server builds the VPN, opens UDP 37853 and starts it.
server.3: The protocol is AmneziaWG: WireGuard whose packets a DPI does not recognise, with settings of its own made for your server.
